list.emptyBody: Add your first printer to start tracking prints and maintenance.

form.name: Name
form.machinePresetHint: The slicer's settings for this printer, used when a plate is sliced for it.
form.machinePresetNozzle: Saving sets the printer's nozzle to {{nozzle}} mm.
form.processPresetHint: Used for project plates that don't pick their own, when this is the default printer.
form.powerHint: Used to estimate energy for prints without a measurement.
form.numberHint: Leave empty for the next free number.
form.numberTaken: Another printer already has this number. It may be archived.

usage.title: Correct usage
usage.intro: Type the totals {{name}} shows. The difference from what the app counted is saved, and prints logged later add on top.
usage.noteHint: Optional, e.g. where the numbers come from.
usage.saveError: Couldn't save the usage. Try again.

comments.title: Notes
comments.label: Add a note
comments.placeholder: e.g. X axis clicking, part ordered

costs.title: Costs
costs.lifetimeHint: Purchase price is spread over these hours as wear. 0 leaves wear out; empty uses the default from Costs settings.
costs.maintenanceHint: Spreads what you logged on maintenance tasks over the runtime.
costs.countHint: Prints made while it was on a printer pay its wear and maintenance.
costs.countHintPrinter: Off leaves this printer's wear and maintenance out of costs. Its accessories follow their own setting.

accessories.title: Accessories
accessories.empty: No accessories yet. AMS units, hotends, enclosures and the like go here.

form.numberTaken: Another accessory already has this number. It may be archived.

history.title: Install history
history.deleteBody: The install period is removed from the history. This can't be undone.

onPrinter.installBody: Leave the removal date empty if it's still on the printer, or fill it to record a past period.
onPrinter.noneFree: Every accessory is on a printer. Create a new one first.
onPrinter.removeBody: It stays in the history with this removal date.
onPrinter.overlap: It was on a printer during that period. Pick another date.
onPrinter.badDates: The removal can't be before the install.

catalog.duplicate: An entry with this name already exists. It may be archived.

models.title: Printer models
models.powerHint: Pre-filled on new printers of this model.
